# Console loadout regression

`console-one-checkmark.png` retains only the staff ability and playsheet area from the user-reported Xbox capture `yBYtANeDZK`. The rest of the 1600 × 900 frame is transparent, removing coach, team, account and gamertag information while preserving the production decoder's geometry and pixels.

The six staff cards are Island Kings, Inside Stuffed, Sideline 2 Sideline, Sheddables, Mano A Mano and Practician QB. Only the final card has a checkmark. Playsheets are Dollar, Run Stop, Nickel and Air Raid Gun. The regression verifies reference matching and independently supplied layout/lettering observations; the release evidence records separate live Workers AI acceptance on the original capture.
